actual_hs_list: 130232 (Guar gum powder / guar gum, whether or not refined — from guar seed endosperm)
130232 (Guar splits — semi-processed guar endosperm, same heading as guar gum)
120799 or 0713.90 (Guar seeds — whole seed, not a gum; oilseed/leguminous seed heading, NOT chapter 13)
230250 / 230990 (Guar meal 'churi' and 'korma' — guar seed cake/meal residues for animal feed, chapter 23)
130232 (Organic guar gum powder — same HS as conventional guar gum; organic status is not a separate HS line)
product_summary: Website gumking.in (homepage, read 2026) presents the company as 'Manufacturer and Exporter of Guar Gum Products and its Derivatives'. Listed product lines: Guar Gum Powder; Organic Guar Gum Powder; Guar Meal (Churi); Guar Meal (Korma); Guar Seeds; Guar Splits. Stated applications: food, pharma, cosmetics, textiles, oil & gas drilling, paper, mining; guar meal marketed as dairy/livestock feed protein. No gum arabic, gum karaya, tamarind kernel powder, cassia gum or other non-guar natural gums are listed anywhere on the site. Source: https://www.gumking.in/ (homepage product grid and 'Latest Products' section).
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — site self-describes as 'Manufacturer and Exporter' with own quality-control and packaging/warehousing sections, but no plant address, GST, IEC or certification documents are published on the homepage; sub-pages (/products/, /about-us/, /contact-us/) return HTTP 404, so the manufacturing claim is заявлено, не подтверждено. Guar meal and guar seeds trading is consistent with a trader/processor hybrid.
comment: HS mapping: declared 130232 is CORRECT and is the core code — guar gum powder and guar splits both fall under 130232. Declared 130190 (other natural gums, incl. gum arabic/karaya) and 130239 (mucilages from other vegetable sources) are NOT corroborated by any product on the site: no gum arabic, karaya, cassia or tamarind product is offered. Those two codes look like a generic 'natural gums' template and should be treated as unsupported. Conversely, the declaration is MISSING the company's real second revenue line: guar meal (churi/korma) and guar seeds, which are chapter 23 (oilcake/feed residues) and chapter 12 (guar seed) goods, not chapter 13 gums. Recommended corrected list: 130232 (primary), plus 230250/230990 for guar meal and 120799/0713.90 for guar seeds — to be confirmed against actual invoice descriptions. Industry classification 'Нефтегаз и химия' is a misclassification of the primary activity: this is an agro-processing / natural-gum (food-hydrocolloid) supplier; oil & gas is only an end-use application of guar gum as a drilling-fluid viscosifier, not the company's industry. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT grounds for rejection — company is retained with corrected codes (accepted_hs_corrected). All product claims are from the company's own website only; no customs line, B/L or GST record was checked in this HS-only pass, therefore every product line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Revenue, export volume, CIN/PAN/GST/IEC: not researched in this role and not public on the homepage — null.
